findings.title: Budget refresh failure escapes as unhandled rejection
findings.problem: finishBudgetAction awaits onBudgetsChanged (refreshBudgets -> projectBudgetsStore.listProjectBudgets, which toasts and rethrows on failure) in try/finally with no catch. In the bulk reset path BulkResetBudgetsPopup calls onSave() un-awaited, so the rejection is an unhandled promise rejection. In the bulk override path (line 236) the rejection propagates into BulkBudgetOverrideModal's submit handler, after the success/partial-failure toast was already shown.
findings.impact: A failed budget refresh after a successful bulk override or reset surfaces as an uncaught error (console/global error handlers) even though the store already toasted it. Reachability confirmed: listProjectBudgets rethrows and the reset popup does not await onSave.
findings.recommendation: Catch refresh errors inside finishBudgetAction since the store already toasts: try { await onBudgetsChanged?.() } catch { /* store already toasts */ } finally { closePopup(true) }.
